title: Relation of chapter to other laws.
bodyText: The rights and remedies in this chapter shall be cumulative and in addition to any and all rights and remedies that may exist under applicable state and federal laws.
bodyHtml: [§195D-28]  Relation of chapter to other laws.  The rights and remedies in this chapter shall be cumulative and in addition to any and all rights and remedies that may exist under applicable state and federal laws. [L 1997, c 380, pt of §2]
